prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a drifting pitch-black silhouette of a man from the waist up, no legs, the lower body and the ragged edges dissolving into wisps of black smoke, long thin black arms with clawed fingers, two glowing white eye points in the dark head; it hovers, nothing touches the ground; in every cell it floats at the same height in its box with clear empty space below it. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: two white eye points in the black silhouette, nothing else.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, drifting forward and reaching a long clawed black hand out at the heroes, the smoke wisps trailing back, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, the silhouette tearing at the edges, the arms flung up, the wisps scattering, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Tilt the whole body along a strong diagonal, reach the limbs, wisps, tendrils or wings far from the body, and let trailing parts lag behind the motion. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, hovering above the ground, nothing touches the ground, no shadow, no water. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a face, a mouth, clothes, a hood, chains, legs, colours other than black and grey.
